name: ToasterService
description: A toast notification system built on the Sonner library. Consists of two exports: a Toaster component that mounts the toast container infrastructure, and a toast API object with methods for triggering success, error, info, and warning notifications. Each toast type has a corresponding Lucide icon (CheckCircle, OctagonX, Info, TriangleAlert).

props.name: position
props.description: The screen position where toast notifications appear.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: When true, each toast displays a close button.

subComponents.name: Toaster
subComponents.description: The container component that must be mounted once in your app (typically in a root layout). Renders the Sonner Toaster with custom Lucide icons for each toast type.

props.name: position
props.description: Screen corner or edge where toasts appear.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Whether toasts show a close button.

subComponents.name: toast
subComponents.description: An API object (not a component) with four methods for dispatching notifications: toast.success(), toast.error(), toast.info(), and toast.warning(). Each accepts a message string and an optional description string.

props.name: toast.success
props.description: Displays a success toast with a CheckCircle icon.

props.name: toast.error
props.description: Displays an error toast with an OctagonX icon.

props.name: toast.info
props.description: Displays an info toast with an Info icon.

props.name: toast.warning
props.description: Displays a warning toast with a TriangleAlert icon.

accessibility.keyboard: Toasts can be dismissed via close button (Tab to focus, Enter/Space to activate). Escape may dismiss the most recent toast depending on Sonner configuration.
accessibility.aria: Sonner manages aria-live regions for toast announcements. Success/info toasts use polite announcements; error/warning toasts use assertive announcements.
accessibility.notes: Mount the Toaster component once in your application root. Each toast type has a distinct icon for visual differentiation. The loading state uses a spinning Loader2 icon.
